purpose: Define a reversible, evidence-backed provisional taxonomy for Korean banner occurrence rows without finalizing the production bannerType enum or canonical banner schema.

coreDecision.reason: The current scheduleType field mixes different semantic dimensions: new expresses lifecycle, single/dual/triple express pickup cardinality/display behavior, and wish expresses summon mechanic. A single provisional bannerType would preserve that ambiguity instead of resolving it.

mechanicFamily.description: What kind of summon/banner behavior the occurrence represents.

values.meaning: Ordinary hero pickup occurrence, including new and rerun forms.
Wish/selectable summon occurrence. Selection-list semantics are separate relations and are not inferred from pickup cardinality.
Special banner concept that cannot safely be represented as ordinary pickup or wish. No current 94-row assignment is forced solely because the product design requires a special-banner surface.
Use when evidence is insufficient or a future occurrence does not fit the observed families.

lifecycle.description: Whether the Korean occurrence is presented as a new release or a rerun/return occurrence.

pickupCardinality.description: Number/form of featured pickup heroes when that property is explicitly supported. This is not derived from bannerCode numbering.

contextTags.description: Non-exclusive modifiers that must not replace the main mechanic/lifecycle/cardinality axes.

values.meaning: Collaboration context. It is a tag because collaboration can still be a NEW PICKUP occurrence.
Occurrence reusing an already verified legacy source/banner mapping.
Recorded source linkage conflicts with raw ConfigData evidence and must remain explicit until relation repair.

Reserved for CP banner/pickup-log relationships required by the product design. Stage 1-3 does not prove that CP is a mutually exclusive banner mechanic, so no current occurrence is assigned automatically.

legacyScheduleTypeMapping.reason: Current NEW rows can contain different featured-hero counts, so cardinality must come from explicit source/relation evidence rather than from scheduleType=new.
Current Korean schedule uses single for one-hero rerun occurrences.
Current Korean schedule uses dual for two-hero rerun occurrences.
Current Korean schedule uses triple for three-hero selected/rerun occurrences.
Wish banners use selectable-pool semantics; treating the two chosen heroes as ordinary DUAL pickup would collapse different mechanics.
Unknown future or exceptional rows remain explicit rather than being guessed into a known type.

sourceTypePolicy.rule: Keep sourceType as source-pool classification evidence and never overwrite it with the occurrence taxonomy.
sourceTypePolicy.importantExample: A sourceType=new record may later appear in the Korean schedule as lifecycle=RERUN and pickupCardinality=SINGLE.

representativeFixtures.note: One-hero NEW example; cardinality is intentionally not encoded by scheduleType=new.
Two-hero NEW example demonstrating that new is not a cardinality type.
Collaboration is modeled as a non-exclusive tag rather than a top-level mutually exclusive banner type.
Demonstrates source classification and occurrence classification are different axes.
Manual occurrence remains taxonomically valid without CardPool identity.
Taxonomy can be assigned from occurrence evidence while the incorrect source relation remains unresolved and separately flagged.

productRequirementBoundary.cp: The design requires a CP banner pickup-log surface, but current Stage 1 evidence does not establish CP as a mutually exclusive source/occurrence banner type. Keep CP_RELATED reserved for relation census.
productRequirementBoundary.special: The design requires explanations for special banner concepts. SPECIAL is therefore reserved, but no current 94-row occurrence is forced into SPECIAL without evidence.
productRequirementBoundary.wish: Wish summon is independently supported by both current schedule records and the design requirement for selectable-character lists.
productRequirementBoundary.singleRerun: The design explicitly requires rerun history for important one-person pickup characters, consistent with lifecycle=RERUN plus pickupCardinality=SINGLE.

prohibitedShortcuts: Do not define COLLAB as a mutually exclusive banner mechanic when it can coexist with NEW pickup.
Do not infer pickup cardinality from bannerCode, slotCode, asset filename, or source record ordering.
Do not classify WISH as DUAL merely because the user may choose two heroes.
Do not classify CP as a proven banner mechanic before relation census establishes its data unit and relationship.
Do not erase sourceType when producing occurrence taxonomy.
Do not silently repair SOURCE_CONFLICT records during taxonomy work.
notDecided: Final production bannerType enum or field layout
Whether the final consumer stores the axes as columns, tags, or normalized relations
Exact lifecycle for each wish occurrence
Cardinality for NEW occurrences until explicit relation evidence is consumed

consume: Preserve sourceType separately from occurrence taxonomy.
Resolve Hero relations only through explicit source IDs and canonical Hero identity.
Investigate CP_RELATED and special-banner relationships without forcing them into the current five legacy scheduleType values.
